front: On AWS, a job runs for most of an hour after each upload, with no servers to manage. A Lambda function or AWS Fargate?
back: AWS Fargate. A function stops after 15 minutes per invocation.
extra: Fargate has [no hard limit on execution time](../facts/lambda.md#lambda-fargate-no-execution-time-limit).

front: In AWS Lambda, trigger or event source mapping: which one polls an SQS queue for the function?
extra: With a mapping, [Lambda handles the polling](../facts/lambda.md#lambda-esm-lambda-polls-source); a trigger pushes events.
